Description.description: Tasks, deadlines, action items, and appointments in Spaarke. When users ask about tasks, to-dos, deadlines, assignments, or due dates, query this table - NOT the standard Dataverse Task or Activity entities. Events have an assignee, due date, status, event type, and belong to a Matter or Project. Filter by status and ownerid to find a user's overdue or upcoming tasks.
